notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary directed-interaction fan-out across subscription kinds. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies that one by-ownership subscriber and two universal subscribers receive the same two target-addressed interactions in producer order, that universal subscribers also receive an interaction addressed to a different target, that the by-ownership and unsubscribed members do not, and that target identity, interaction class, parameter value, user tag, producing federate, and transportation metadata are preserved. Timestamped delivery, regions/DDM, custom transportation, MOM, save/restore, and provider-private behavior remain outside this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object/interaction/parameter lookup, object publication, by-ownership and universal directed-interaction publication/subscription, object registration, ordinary targeted Send Directed Interaction, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, destruction, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery and Receive Directed Interaction callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador mixed directed-interaction fan-out declarations
